source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie,
Here's a summary of my feedback:
\* I definitely like examples 1 and 2 over 3 and 4.
\* I do like the "dark mode" landing page. It looks tech but sophisticated. The purple background you created for 1 and 2 looks great.
\* Highlighting the first sentence of the hero text works really well, better than the tag line.
\* I like the look of Alan Sans, at least in the headline text. It feels warmer and more approachable (now they've got me at it!).
\* Surprisingly (to me) the green color works well for buttons.
\* I'm in two minds over the single color vs two color logo
\* Not sure if the screens are a place holder. They could be an interesting approach to explore.
\* Did you envisage adding the rest of the initial copy to the landing page or moving it to follow-on pages?
\* Do you plan to have a common page footer?
I'm looking forward to your next updates.
Mark

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie, I've reviewed the full landing page example you provided. Now that I see it I don't think the follow-on copy I provided is right for the landing page, however your designs gave me some great ideas. I think the next thing to follow the initial hero section should be How it Works. If a prospect is interested this is what they will want to know next. Your chevron-down icons are perfect for this as they indicate a sequence, something like:

**How it Works**

\* Sign up by specifying an account administrator and your company details
\* Add background about your company, for example by scanning your website
\* Create an agent by business role, then choose a name and select a voice
\* Optionally connect your agent to one of our collaborative applications
\* Add instructions for your agent - they can be updated at any time
\* Create a company email address for your agent and authorize access
\* Invite staff to use the dashboard to chat and message your agent
\* Connect an extension from your switchboard to the agent's phone
\* You're now ready to introduce your agent and have them start work

I'll have more feedback but wanted to pass this on while it was fresh. Mark

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie,

Good to hear from you, I hope your trip to Spain was fun! I have been doing a lot of work on the website and the UI and both are shaping up quite well. My priority right now is to finish fleshing out the website before it (hopefully) gets a lot of traffic.

I have added a header menu to the site (not yet live) with associated pages in varying levels of completeness. Two of these pages are solution descriptions for the platform and agents, per the attached snapshots. These pages each include space for a diagram for which I have created rough drafts.

I am hoping you can help me turn these into production versions that I can add to the site. If not maybe you can recommend the best approach to doing this.

I have also developed the UI further, which I am now calling the Console, and added more functionality. I have also finalized a look-and-feel and layout I am comfortable with, although it still needs a little bit of polish in terms of shades and tones. I will get you a link you can use to review it.

Regards,
Mark
